name: Can I relist my luxury property with the same agent if it expired?

mainEntity.name: Can I relist my luxury property with the same agent if it expired?

acceptedAnswer.text: While it is possible to relist with the same agent, it's often advisable to consider why the property didn't sell previously and if a change in strategy or representation might be beneficial. A practical tradeoff to consider is loyalty versus a fresh perspective and new marketing approach. Kelby Contreras offers a comprehensive review to determine if a new strategy, advanced marketing techniques, and a wider network of luxury buyers could lead to a more successful outcome for your property in areas like West Palm Beach or Hollywood Beach.
acceptedAnswer.description: You can relist with the same agent, but consider if a new strategy or representation would be more beneficial. A fresh perspective often brings new marketing approaches.
